name: Wild Lights Holiday Trail at Oatland Island
when_note: It runs on Saturday and Sunday evenings only, with three arrival windows each night: 5:30 to 6:30, 6:30 to 7:30 and 7:30 to 8:30.
cost: Adults $12; children, military and seniors $10; ages 3 and under free
paras: A lit section of the animal park's woodland trail opens after dark for the first time this year. Admission includes hot cocoa and cider, a cookie decorating station and a digital scavenger hunt along the way.
Photo spots in the barn yard change by night. Santa appears on Nov. 29 and Dec. 13, Buddy the Elf on Dec. 5 and 12, and the Grinch on Dec. 6, 19 and 20. Ticket sales support the animal care team.
tip: Pick your night by the character you want, since the barn yard photo guest differs each date and tickets are sold per night.

name: Tybee Island Annual Christmas Tree Lighting
when_note: The ceremony starts at 6:00 PM on the Saturday after Thanksgiving, so plan to arrive early for a spot near the tree.
paras: The island's holiday kickoff gathers neighbors around the Christmas tree for live entertainment, caroling and sweet treats before a countdown to the lighting.
The setting is the Tybrisa Street roundabout, a short walk from the beach, so it works as an easy evening stop for families already on the island for the weekend.
tip: Bring a light jacket, since the island breeze off the water makes November evenings feel cooler than in Savannah.

name: Santa's Wonderland Free Photos at Bass Pro Shops Savannah
when_note: Photo hours are 10 AM to 8 PM on weekdays and Saturdays and 10 AM to 5 PM on Sundays, with shorter hours on Thanksgiving Day and Christmas Eve.
paras: Each family gets a free 4x6 photo with Santa and a free shareable video. Printed photo packages are sold separately for families who want more copies.

Weekday visitors can also pick up free giveaways while supplies last, including a Santa ornament craft through Nov. 27 and a sticker-by-number sheet from Nov. 30 to Dec. 18. Reservations are strongly encouraged online.
tip: Reserve a time slot online up to a week ahead, because walk-ins wait behind booked families.
